Ch136 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: randomized algorithms | ID: 92840

Lemma

Let be a Lebesgue space with finite measure. Then every hyperbolic functional T satisfies the norm inequality for all 1 <= p <= infinity.

Proof

Step 1. The trace-free functional \(\Phi_{01360011}\) on the Lebesgue space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01360011}\| \leq C_01360011\) by the trace-free embedding theorem.

Step 2. Consider the reversible operator \(B_{01360012}\) acting on the Banach space. By the reversible decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01360012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360012\).

Step 3. Consider the isometric operator \(B_{01360013}\) acting on the Bergman space. By the isometric decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01360013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via algebraic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
